01862 Darda` {dar-dah'}

顯然源於 01858 和 01843; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Darda 1; 1

達大 = "知識之珠"
1) 瑪曷的兒子之一, 是所羅門王時代四位以智慧著稱的人之一, 但其智慧仍不及所羅門王 (#王上4:31|)
record.edic_text:
01862 Darda` {dar-dah'}

apparently from 01858 and 01843;; n pr m

AV - Darda 1; 1

Darda = "pearl of knowledge"
1) a son of Mahol, one of four men of great fame for their wisdom,
   but surpassed by Solomon
